rules.statement: Where, in an action instituted in a Court of requests, the claim and counterclaim are intimately connected and right to possession of immovable property is involved in both the claims, the defendant would be entitled to have the case transferred to the District Court if the Court of Requests has no jurisdiction to entertain the claim in reconvention.
